contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP TETRICVS P F] AVG ; R/ VICTORIA AVG

A Roman copper-alloy coin. Radiate of Tetricus I (271-274). (Reece period 13). Unknown mint. Obverse inscription: [IMP TETRICVS P F] AVG. Obverse description: Radiate bust facing right. Reverse inscription: VICTORIA AVG. Reverse description: Victory running left, holding wreath and palm. Diameter: 17.94 mm; Thickness: 1.34 mm; Weight: 1.63g
